styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a purple void-edge floor with cliff lips. It carries about 5 visible tones per tile, against 3 for the grass reference and 7 for the paving reference, so it sits between them. Near-flat coverage is 5%, so there are no large flat fills. Its dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outlines lean purple, which is a dark material tone rather than a black sticker line. It is acceptable but a little flatter than the strongest reference, and when in doubt it should fail.
